code_review_findings.evidence: Code shows proper variant dropdown implementation: <select> with options mapped from (cat?.variants || []).filter(v => v.active !== false), displaying 'Warna · Size · SKU' format. Dropdown appears when catalog_item_id is selected and variants exist.

Code shows SearchableSelect for rahaza_variant_id with options from rahazaVariants[item.model_id], displaying SKU with sub-label 'color_name · size_code'. Dropdown populated after model selection via fetchRahazaVariants(). Validation enforces variant selection (line 308-310).

code_review_findings.keluhan: #5 - Terima FG dari CMT (One Table, Inline Edit)
code_review_findings.evidence: TABS array shows only 2 statuses: 'on_qc' (Sedang QC) and 'completed_qc' (Selesai QC), plus 'all'. Table uses expand/collapse pattern (line 409-412) with inline NumBox inputs for qty_actual and reject_qty (lines 490-498). NO separate modal/page. Single 'Selesaikan QC' button (line 434-437).

For completed receipts with reject > 0, two buttons render: 'Permak sendiri' (line-permak-{id}) and 'Retur ke CMT' (line-retur-{id}). Reject queue panel (lines 296-353) shows undecided rejects with same action buttons. Dialog (rework-dialog) handles both types with proper backend calls.

Table headers include 'Lolos QC', 'Reject', 'Rework' columns (line 314). Vendor summary cards show total_accepted, total_reject, total_rework_open with proper formatting (lines 260-275). Job rows display accepted_qty, reject_qty, rework_open_qty with color coding (lines 365-370).
